problem.title: Your university life doesn't fit in five different apps
problem.subtitle: Announcements live in a messaging group, events in each student center's account, and sign-ups in forms someone reconciles by hand. Bandada U brings it all together.
problem.beforeA: Announcements lost among hundreds of group messages.
problem.beforeB: Events scattered across each student center's networks.
problem.beforeC: QR payments and spreadsheets reconciled by hand.
problem.beforeD: Fake profiles and no certainty about who is a student.
problem.afterA: One feed with your program, your groups and your classmates.
problem.afterB: A single events calendar with real-time seats.
problem.afterC: Credit-based registration and an automatic QR ticket.
problem.afterD: Identity verified with your institutional email.

features.title: Everything you need to live the university
features.subtitle: Built for students, organizers and moderators, with campus-grade connectivity in mind.
features.identityBody: You sign up with your institutional email and confirm a code. Inside there are only real students from your university.
features.communityBody: Post text and images, follow classmates and join subject groups, public or private.
features.eventsBody: Register for workshops and talks paying with credits. You get your QR entry, and if something fails you are refunded automatically.
features.walletBody: Top up, check your balance and review your transactions. Every operation is safe and never charged twice.
features.organizersBody: Publish events with capacity and price, and let the moderation team review reported content from a dedicated panel.
features.themeBody: Pick the theme you prefer or let it follow your device. Available in Spanish and English.

how.title: From zero to your first ticket in three steps
how.step1Body: Sign up with your institutional email and confirm the code we send you.
how.step2Body: Complete your profile, follow your classmates and join the groups for your subjects.
how.step3Body: Top up credits, register for an event and show your QR at the door.

faq.title: What people ask us the most
faq.a1: Students with an institutional email from an enabled university. That way only real people from your community are inside the network.
faq.a2: Signing up and using the network is free. You only pay, with credits from your wallet, for events that have a price; free events cost nothing.
faq.a3: You top up credits in your wallet and use them to register for events. If a registration fails or you cancel in time, the charge is refunded automatically.
faq.q4: How do I get into an event?
faq.a4: When you register you get a ticket with a QR code in the app. The organizer scans it at the door and your attendance is recorded.
faq.a5: Anyone can report a post. The moderation team reviews it from the panel and can hide or approve it.
faq.q6: Is there an English version and dark mode?
faq.a6: Yes. Bandada U is available in Spanish and English and has light and dark mode, automatic or your choice.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what data Bandada U processes, what it uses it for and what rights you have over it. Bandada U is an academic project for the Software Engineering II course (Group 24).
privacy.s1Body: Institutional email, name, university, program, semester and interests that you provide; the content you post; your registrations, tickets and credit transactions; and the minimum technical data needed to run the service, such as your preferred language and theme.
privacy.s2Title: What we use your data for
privacy.s2Body: To verify your identity as a student, show you your feed and groups, manage your registrations and wallet, send you service notifications and keep the platform safe and moderated.
privacy.s3Body: We do not sell your data. Event organizers only see the data needed to manage your registration. The moderation team may review reported content.
privacy.s4Body: This site stores only your language and theme preferences in your browser, to remember them. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies.
privacy.s5Body: You can access your data, correct it or ask for its deletion by contacting the project team. We will handle your request within a reasonable time.
privacy.s6Body: If we update this policy, we will publish the new version on this page with its update date.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: By using Bandada U you accept these terms. Bandada U is an academic project for the Software Engineering II course (Group 24), and the service is provided as is.
terms.s1Body: You need an institutional email from an enabled university. You are responsible for the security of your account and the accuracy of your data.
terms.s2Body: You are responsible for what you post. Illegal, violent or sexually explicit content, harassment and impersonation are not allowed. We may hide content and suspend accounts that break these rules.
terms.s3Body: Credits are used to register for events within the platform. If a registration cannot be completed or is cancelled within the event's deadline, the charge is refunded in credits. In this version, credit top-ups are simulated.
terms.s4Body: We do our best to keep the service available, but we do not guarantee it will run without interruptions or errors.
terms.s5Body: The Bandada U brand and software belong to their authors. You keep the rights to the content you post and allow us to display it within the platform.
terms.s6Body: We may update these terms. If you keep using the service after an update, you accept it.
